test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the cyclone that hit Odisha and West Bengal in May 2020.
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Amphan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The cyclone that hit Odisha and West Bengal in May 2020 is **"Amphan"**.
 
• The super cyclonic storm **Amphan** got this name from **Thailand**, The word 'Amphan' is pronounced as **'Um-pun' which means sky**.
 
• **Amphan** originated from a low-pressure area persisting a couple of hundred miles (300 km) east of Colombo, Sri Lanka, on 13 May 2020.
 
• On 20 May 2020, **Cyclone Amphan** cut a swathe through the northern part of the Indian state of **Odisha**, before bearing down on the state of** West Bengal**, with a wind speed of **185 kilometres per hour**.
 
• **Coastal areas in West Bengal** comprising East Midnapore, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Kolkata, Hooghly, and Howrah as well as **Odisha** were affected by the cyclone. It also caused significant destruction in** Bangladesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Cyclone Name**
 **Description**
 
 

 Fani
 
 
Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm **Fani** was the worst tropical cyclone to strike the Indian state of Odisha since **26 April 2019.**

 
The highest **wind speed was 250 Km/h**. 

 
Affected areas: East India, Odisha, Bangladesh, Andhra Pradesh, Sri Lanka, and Bhutan. 

 
 
 

 Bulbul
 
 
The cyclone** Bulbul** hit the coastal districts of **West Bengal and Odisha** on** 5 November 2019**.

 
It made landfall between the Sagar Islands of West Bengal and Khepupara in Bangladesh.

 
The highest wind speed was 155 Km/h. 

 
 
 

 Hudhud
 
 
**Hudhud** was a strong tropical cyclone that caused widespread damage to the state of **Andhra Pradesh in India on 8 October 2014**.

 
The most affected region was **Visakhapatnam** along with districts of Vizianagaram and Srikakulam of the state. 

 
The highest wind speed was 215 Km/h. 

 
The word **Hudhud comes from Arabic** and refers to the Hoopoe bird.
